ch-sql-names.correct: SELECT name, city FROM customers ORDER BY customer_id;

ch-sql-price-boundary.correct: SELECT product_id, name FROM products WHERE category = 'ware' AND price >= 20 ORDER BY product_id;
ch-sql-price-boundary.wrong: SELECT product_id, name FROM products WHERE category = 'ware' AND price > 20 ORDER BY product_id;

ch-sql-paid-dates.correct: SELECT order_id FROM orders WHERE status = 'paid' AND order_date >= '2026-01-02' ORDER BY order_id;
ch-sql-paid-dates.wrong: SELECT order_id FROM orders WHERE status = 'paid' AND order_date > '2026-01-02' ORDER BY order_id;

ch-sql-top-prices.correct: SELECT product_id, price FROM products ORDER BY price DESC, product_id ASC LIMIT 3;
ch-sql-top-prices.wrong: SELECT product_id, price FROM products ORDER BY price DESC, product_id DESC LIMIT 3;

ch-sql-distinct-cities.correct: SELECT city FROM customers GROUP BY city ORDER BY MIN(customer_id);
ch-sql-distinct-cities.wrong: SELECT city FROM customers ORDER BY city;

ch-sql-customer-orders.correct: SELECT o.order_id, c.name FROM orders AS o JOIN customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'paid' ORDER BY o.order_id;
ch-sql-customer-orders.wrong: SELECT o.order_id, c.name FROM orders AS o JOIN customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id ORDER BY o.order_id;

ch-sql-never-ordered.correct: SELECT c.name FROM customers AS c LEFT JOIN orders AS o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE o.order_id IS NULL ORDER BY c.customer_id;
ch-sql-never-ordered.wrong: SELECT c.name FROM customers AS c JOIN orders AS o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE o.order_id IS NULL;

ch-sql-line-totals.correct: SELECT p.name, oi.quantity, p.price * oi.quantity AS line_total FROM order_items AS oi JOIN products AS p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE oi.order_id = 101 ORDER BY oi.item_id;
ch-sql-line-totals.wrong: SELECT p.name, oi.quantity, p.price AS line_total FROM order_items AS oi JOIN products AS p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE oi.order_id = 101 ORDER BY oi.item_id;

ch-sql-order-counts.correct: SELECT c.name, COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count FROM customers AS c LEFT JOIN orders AS o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name ORDER BY c.customer_id;
ch-sql-order-counts.wrong: SELECT c.name, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM customers AS c LEFT JOIN orders AS o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name ORDER BY c.customer_id;

ch-sql-repeat-paid.correct: SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) AS paid_orders FROM orders WHERE status = 'paid' GROUP BY customer_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2 ORDER BY customer_id;
ch-sql-repeat-paid.wrong: SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) AS paid_orders FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2 ORDER BY customer_id;

ch-sql-paid-revenue.correct: SELECT p.name, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 'paid' THEN p.price * oi.quantity ELSE 0 END), 0) AS revenue FROM products AS p LEFT JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.product_id = p.product_id LEFT JOIN orders AS o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id GROUP BY p.product_id, p.name ORDER BY p.product_id;
ch-sql-paid-revenue.wrong: SELECT p.name, SUM(p.price * oi.quantity) AS revenue FROM products AS p JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.product_id = p.product_id JOIN orders AS o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id GROUP BY p.product_id, p.name ORDER BY p.product_id;

ch-sql-above-average.correct: SELECT name, price FROM products WHERE price > (SELECT AVG(price) FROM products) ORDER BY product_id;
ch-sql-above-average.wrong: SELECT name, price FROM products WHERE price > (SELECT MIN(price) FROM products) ORDER BY product_id;

ch-sql-no-paid.correct: SELECT c.name FROM customers AS c LEFT JOIN orders AS o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id AND o.status = 'paid' WHERE o.order_id IS NULL ORDER BY c.customer_id;
ch-sql-no-paid.wrong: SELECT c.name FROM customers AS c JOIN orders AS o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE o.status <> 'paid' ORDER BY c.customer_id;

ch-sql-bought-mug.correct: SELECT DISTINCT c.name FROM customers AS c JOIN orders AS o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id AND o.status = 'paid' JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products AS p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE p.name = 'Mug' ORDER BY c.customer_id;
ch-sql-bought-mug.wrong: SELECT DISTINCT c.name FROM customers AS c JOIN orders AS o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products AS p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE p.category = ware ORDER BY c.customer_id;

ch-sql-row-number.correct: SELECT customer_id, order_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY order_date, order_id) AS order_number FROM orders ORDER BY customer_id, order_number;
ch-sql-row-number.wrong: SELECT customer_id, order_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY order_date, order_id) AS order_number FROM orders ORDER BY customer_id, order_number;

ch-sql-price-rank.correct: SELECT product_id, price, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY price DESC) AS price_rank FROM products ORDER BY price DESC, product_id;
ch-sql-price-rank.wrong: SELECT product_id, price, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY price DESC) AS price_rank FROM products ORDER BY price DESC, product_id;

ch-sql-running-quantity.correct: SELECT item_id, SUM(quantity) OVER (ORDER BY item_id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_quantity FROM order_items ORDER BY item_id;
ch-sql-running-quantity.wrong: SELECT item_id, SUM(quantity) OVER () AS running_quantity FROM order_items ORDER BY item_id;

ch-sql-category-totals.correct: SELECT product_id, category, SUM(price) OVER (PARTITION BY category) AS category_total FROM products ORDER BY product_id;
ch-sql-category-totals.wrong: SELECT product_id, category, SUM(price) OVER (ORDER BY product_id) AS category_total FROM products ORDER BY product_id;

ch-sql-build-revenue-report.correct: WITH order_totals AS (SELECT o.order_id, o.customer_id, SUM(p.price * oi.quantity) AS revenue FROM orders AS o JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products AS p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status = 'paid' GROUP BY o.order_id, o.customer_id), customer_totals AS (SELECT customer_id, SUM(revenue) AS revenue FROM order_totals GROUP BY customer_id), report AS (SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, COALESCE(ct.revenue, 0) AS revenue FROM customers AS c LEFT JOIN customer_totals AS ct ON ct.customer_id = c.customer_id) SELECT name, revenue, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY revenue DESC) AS rank FROM report ORDER BY revenue DESC, customer_id;
ch-sql-build-revenue-report.wrong: SELECT c.name, SUM(p.price * oi.quantity) AS revenue, 1 AS rank FROM customers AS c JOIN orders AS o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products AS p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status = 'paid' GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name;

ch-sql-boss-paid-ledger.correct: WITH order_totals AS (SELECT o.order_id, o.customer_id, o.order_date, SUM(p.price * oi.quantity) AS revenue FROM orders AS o JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products AS p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status = 'paid' GROUP BY o.order_id, o.customer_id, o.order_date), ledger AS (SELECT customer_id, order_id, order_date, revenue, SUM(revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY order_date, order_id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_revenue FROM order_totals) SELECT c.name, l.order_id, l.revenue, l.running_revenue FROM ledger AS l JOIN customers AS c ON c.customer_id = l.customer_id ORDER BY l.customer_id, l.order_date, l.order_id;
ch-sql-boss-paid-ledger.wrong: SELECT c.name, o.order_id, p.price * oi.quantity AS revenue, SUM(p.price * oi.quantity) OVER (PARTITION BY c.customer_id ORDER BY o.order_date, o.order_id) AS running_revenue FROM customers AS c JOIN orders AS o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products AS p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status = 'paid' ORDER BY c.customer_id, o.order_date, o.order_id;
